digest.headline: Japanese bond yields reached record highs as long-term borrowing costs climbed following the end of past central bank caps.

lede.b: The ten-year Japanese government bond yield reached 3.02% and the thirty-year yield hit 4.18%. This jump in borrowing costs happens because past central bank yield limits ended. Japanese financial institutions are now changing how they price mortgages. The Japanese currency also climbed to briefly touch the low 158 level against the dollar.
lede.i: The ten-year Japanese government bond yield reached 3.02% while the thirty-year yield hit 4.18%. This rise in long-term borrowing costs reflects the end of past central bank yield caps. Japanese financial institutions are now revising their mortgage pricing strategies. The Japanese currency climbed sharply against the dollar to touch the low 158 level.
lede.a: The ten-year Japanese government bond yield reached 3.02% and the thirty-year yield hit 4.18% as past central bank yield caps expired. Japanese financial institutions adjusted their mortgage pricing strategies to reflect these structural increases in long-term borrowing costs. The Japanese currency climbed to the low 158 level against the dollar amid ongoing speculation regarding official intervention. Traders continued to unwind positions as exchange rate volatility persisted.

Japan.label: Japan
Japan.sub: Japanese bond yields climb as the yen surges against the dollar

stories.t: Japanese Bond Yields Climb to Records
stories.b: The ten-year Japanese bond yield reached 3.02%. The thirty-year yield touched 4.18%. Higher borrowing costs are forcing local banks to rethink mortgages.
stories.i: The ten-year Japanese government bond yield reached 3.02%, while the thirty-year yield hit 4.18%. This rise in long-term borrowing costs reflects the end of past central bank yield caps. Japanese financial institutions are now revising their mortgage pricing strategies.
stories.a: The ten-year Japanese government bond yield touched 3.02% and the thirty-year yield rose to 4.18% as the bond market traded past its historic yield curve control framework. Higher domestic yields are altering asset liability management for commercial lenders, prompting adjustments in retail mortgage products. The ongoing upward pressure on yields stems from persistent central bank policy normalisation.

stories.t: Yen Surges as Intervention Concerns Linger
stories.b: The Japanese currency jumped sharply against the dollar. Traders pushed the exchange rate to touch the low 158 level. Market participants remain focused on potential currency intervention.
stories.i: The Japanese currency climbed sharply against the dollar, pushing the exchange rate to briefly touch the low 158 level. This sudden appreciation follows ongoing speculation regarding official currency intervention. Traders continue to unwind positions as exchange rate volatility persists.
stories.a: The Japanese currency advanced sharply against the dollar to briefly touch the low 158 level. The aggressive move reflects mounting intervention concerns and the ongoing unwinding of leveraged positions. Market participants are actively re-pricing exchange rate risk as authorities monitor currency stability.

politics.b: Japanese officials monitor financial markets closely following sharp currency movements and rising bond yields. Authorities face pressure from shifting borrowing costs and exchange rate fluctuations. Government leaders observe these economic shifts without announcing new policy changes.
politics.i: Japanese policymakers face complex policy trade-offs as domestic bond yields reach multi-year highs and the currency experiences sharp volatility. The central bank navigates the removal of legacy policy frameworks while managing public debt servicing costs. Authorities maintain close surveillance over foreign exchange markets to deter disorderly currency moves.
politics.a: Japanese policymakers confront acute fiscal and monetary policy transmission challenges as sovereign yields break historical boundaries. The interaction between rising debt service costs and currency stability constrains official manoeuvring room. Authorities must balance the normalisation path against financial sector vulnerabilities without explicit forward guidance on intervention triggers.

timeline: The ten-year Japanese government bond yield reaches 3.02% and the thirty-year yield touches 4.18%.
The Japanese currency surges to briefly touch the low 158 level against the dollar.

stories.t: PBOC Sets USD/CNY Central Parity at 6.7829
stories.b: The People's Bank of China set the daily midpoint reference rate for the yuan at 6.7829 per US dollar. This fix sits slightly weaker than the previous rate set by monetary authorities. Commercial banks use this central parity level to guide daily trading bands for the currency.
stories.i: The central bank fixed the USD/CNY central parity at 6.7829, marking a slight depreciation from the prior day. Currency desks monitor this daily benchmark to gauge official tolerance for inflation-adjusted exchange rate flexibility. Foreign exchange markets adjust spot pricing around this managed anchor.
stories.a: The monetary authority set the USD/CNY central parity at 6.7829, registering a marginal weakening against the prior fix. Quantitative models price this signal as a managed easing of currency support to maintain export competitiveness. Arbitrageurs test the daily band limits when capital flows diverge from official parity targets.

stories.t: UBTECH Reports H1 Revenue Surge as Robot Shipments Rise
stories.b: UBTECH doubled its first-half revenue to 1.27 billion yuan. Humanoid robot shipments drove this growth, nearly matching the total volume shipped during the entire previous year. Strong demand for advanced automation equipment lifted financial performance across the board.
stories.i: UBTECH recorded a revenue doubling to 1.27 billion yuan for the first half of the year. Humanoid robot shipments approached total full-year figures from the prior period, indicating scale effects in hardware manufacturing. Margin expansion follows as production volumes absorb fixed overhead costs.
stories.a: UBTECH posted a revenue increase to 1.27 billion yuan, driven by humanoid robot shipments nearing prior full-year aggregates. Equity analysts evaluate this volume surge as a proxy for commercial adoption rates in industrial automation. Valuation multiples reprice when unit economics improve alongside manufacturing scale.

stories.t: NIO Posts Operating Profit of 210 Million Yuan in Q2
stories.b: NIO generated an operating profit of 210 million yuan during the second quarter. This result marks the third consecutive quarter of operating profitability for the electric vehicle manufacturer. Higher vehicle delivery volumes and cost control measures supported the positive financial figures.
stories.i: NIO posted a second-quarter operating profit of 210 million yuan, securing three straight quarters in the black. Electric vehicle margins expanded as production efficiency offset competitive price discounting across the sector. Balance sheet durability strengthens as operating cash flow turns positive.
stories.a: NIO recorded a second-quarter operating profit of 210 million yuan, marking three consecutive profitable quarters. Equity markets price this transition from cash-burn to positive operating cash flow as a milestone for scaling EV makers. Gross margin stability underpins the sustainability of these quarterly earnings.

India.label: India
India.sub: RBI forex inflows reach $136bn while Sensex drops

stories.t: Foreign Exchange Inflows Reach $136 Billion
stories.b: India brought in $136.38bn in foreign currency through special deposit schemes and borrowing programmes. The central bank opened this swap facility to gather foreign money and protect the local currency. Authorised dealer banks reported these massive inflows up to August 31, 2026.
stories.i: India gathered $136.38bn in forex inflows through FCNR(B) deposits and external commercial borrowings. The Reserve Bank of India introduced this USD-INR forex swap facility to build currency reserves and manage inflation pressures. Commercial banks channeled these substantial foreign funds into the domestic financial system before the initial August deadlines.
stories.a: India accumulated $136.38bn via the special USD-INR forex swap facility covering FCNR(B) deposits and ECBs. The Reserve Bank of India leverages these liquidity measures to absorb dollar inflows and manage forward book liabilities. Authorized dealer banks reported these figures as the August 31 window for deposit inflows closed.

stories.t: BSE Sensex Drops to 76,570 as Markets React to Global News
stories.b: The BSE Sensex dropped to 76,570.35 points during the trading session. Indian equities fell as investors reacted to ongoing negotiations between the United States and Iran. Market participants also monitored technical resistance levels near 24,150 for the Nifty index.
stories.i: The BSE Sensex declined to 76,570.35 points amid external market pressures linked to US-Iran diplomatic talks. Indian benchmarks encountered selling pressure near key technical barriers, with the Nifty testing resistance at the 24,150 to 24,200 range. Equity valuations adjusted downward as participants priced in geopolitical developments.
stories.a: The BSE Sensex closed lower at 76,570.35 points against the backdrop of US-Iran diplomatic negotiations. Domestic indices experienced broad-based distribution as the Nifty approached overhead resistance at the 24,150 to 24,200 threshold. Portfolio adjustments reflected heightened sensitivity to external macro risks and shifting risk premiums.

stories.t: RBI Announces Overnight Variable Rate Reverse Repo Auction
stories.b: The Reserve Bank of India scheduled an overnight variable rate reverse repo auction for September 3, 2026. The central bank will absorb 600,000 crore rupees from the banking system through this one-day window. Banks can submit bids between 09:30 AM and 10:00 AM.
stories.i: The Reserve Bank of India announced a overnight variable rate reverse repo auction to drain liquidity from the banking sector. The central bank notified a targeted absorption amount of 600,000 crore rupees with a single-day tenor. Counterparties will execute bids within the morning operational window ahead of the September 4 reversal date.
stories.a: The Reserve Bank of India utilized liquidity management operations by scheduling a 600,000 crore rupee variable rate reverse repo auction with a one-day tenor. The central bank set the bidding window from 09:30 AM to 10:00 AM to sterilize surplus cash reserves ahead of settlement on September 4, 2026. This auction responds to prevailing liquidity conditions observed across the banking system.

politics.b: The Indian government defended its official gross domestic product numbers against recent public criticism. Officials maintained that economic reporting accurately reflects national growth. Authorities continue to promote bilateral trade mechanisms utilizing local currencies.
politics.i: Government officials defended official gross domestic product data release integrity amid ongoing external debates. Policymakers emphasized the structural robustness of bilateral trade frameworks, noting that 96% of commerce between Russia and India now settles through rupee-rouble payment infrastructure. State authorities also advanced the adoption of the e-rupee central bank digital currency.
politics.a: Administration representatives defended national gross domestic product statistics against external scrutiny regarding methodology and growth metrics. Trade officials highlighted that bilateral commerce between Russia and India relies on the rupee-rouble settlement infrastructure for 96% of transactions. Concurrently, state initiatives promoted the integration of the digital rupee central bank digital currency within everyday retail channels.
